messages:
Alex Chen: Morning — quick spotcheck on Nimbus onboarding token usage + throughput. QoW tokens are down ~18% WoW but QoQ are +12%. Median latency jumped from ~140ms to ~220ms yesterday around 14:00 UTC. Anyone seeing related errors or config changes?

Priya Patel: Noticed the active session count dropped after the new onboarding email funnel went live. Spend down ~9% MoM. Could be fewer demos, not necessarily churn.

Samir Rao: I saw an eviction/GPU pressure event on their dedicated pool at 2026-11-23T14:03Z. Logs snippet: ```
2026-11-23T14:03:02Z WARN kv-cache-evict reason=slot_pressure node=gpu-3
upstream_timeout_count=37
p95_latency=310ms
``` Might explain p95 blip. I patched a GC tune at 14:20 UTC.

nimbus-bot: Alert: new deploy for project/nimbus prompted 2xx->3xx response shift at 2026-11-23T13:55:18Z (see deploy link) :rotating_light:

Jordan Lee: Reached out to Nimbus PM — they shipped a prompt template tweak that shortened outputs (more stop tokens) which matches token drop. They plan a canary revert tonight. Renewal convo still green, said they want stable latency for next 30d.

Maya Gomez: Dashboard + CSV here: https://redwood.app/dash/nimbus/throughput?range=14d (heatmap + per-route tokens). Notice route `/chat/onboard` traffic down 24% WoW.

Alex Chen: Good context. Action items: 1) @Priya follow up on customer outreach about demo cadence and run a quick usage playbook tomorrow. 2) @Samir validate GC tune held and monitor p95 for 24h. 3) @Jordan confirm canary revert timing and flag any renewal talking points. 4) @Maya drop the per-route CSV in the renewal doc.

Priya Patel: On it — I'll ping PM and set up a 15m sync with Nimbus success lead.

Samir Rao: GC tune applied; will keep an eye. Added a short-term autoscale rule for that pool to reduce pressure (scale +1 when queue > 60).

Jordan Lee: Canary revert scheduled 02:00 UTC. I'll update renewal notes if latency stabilizes.

Maya Gomez: Uploaded CSV to the renewal doc and annotated the `/chat/onboard` row.

Alex Chen: Thanks all. If QoW doesn't recover by next Tue, we escalate to eng-runtime for a deeper kernel trace. :thumbsup:
